verdict.rationale: PostHog documents several kinds of autonomous background automation. Workflows run on triggers, delays and actions; Self-driving is an ongoing scout-and-agent loop that investigates signals, opens PRs and measures results, turned on with one command. Desktop Cloud agents keep working after the app closes, and CDP pipelines, batch exports, alerts and Replay Vision scanners run in realtime or on a schedule. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that these background automations work reliably in practice.
